mapper.select:
select finprod_id as id, finprod_abbr as text from FIN_PRODUCT WHERE 1 = 1 and FINPROD_TYPE = 'F17'
AND (finprod_id like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR finprod_abbr like '%' || #{search} || '%')
GROUP BY finprod_id, finprod_abbr

select vfp.finprod_id as finprodId, /*资产代码*/ vfp.finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr, /*资产名称*/ fpt.type_1 as assetType, /*资产类型*/ fpt.type_1 as assetTypeCode, /*资产类型*/ vfp.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, to_char(vfp.vdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as vdate1, /*起息日*/ to_char(vfp.mdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as mdate1, /*到期日*/ vfp.profit_type as profitType, /*收益类型*/ vfp.profit_type as profitTypeCode, to_char(vccr.yield)*100 as currentquotation, /*当前报价*/ decode(vfp.profit_type,'02',vccr.basis,'') as basic, /*计息基础*/ vfp.issuer as issuer /*发行人*/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT vfp left join fin_product_type fpt on vfp.finprod_id = fpt.finprod_id left join (select vccr.* from fin_CASH_CALC_RULE vccr where 1 = 1 and vccr.eff_date = (select max(cash_rule.eff_date) from fin_CASH_CALC_RULE cash_rule where cash_rule.finprod_id = vccr.finprod_id and cash_rule.finprod_type = vccr.finprod_type)) vccr on vfp.finprod_id = vccr.finprod_id and vfp.finprod_type = vccr.finprod_type where vfp.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F17'
AND vfp.finprod_id in
#{bond}
AND vfp.profit_type in
#{profitType}
AND fpt.type_1 in
#{assetType}
AND vfp.vdate >= to_date(#{vDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND vfp.vdate <= to_date(#{vDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND vfp.mdate >= to_date(#{mDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND vfp.mdate <= to_date(#{mDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
ORDER BY vccr.eff_date desc
